text:
alex: quick heads-up — ran an interactive DAST + fuzz sweep against staging target /api/v1/ingest and got an auth bypass pattern that looks real. attaching minimal repro. :eyes:

 tara: can you paste the exact request that triggered it? staging had that RBAC toggle flipped last Thurs, might be related.

 alex: pasted below — it's a mutation on the X-User header that normally should be rejected. curl that hits the pathology:

 ```
 curl -i -X POST https://staging.redwood.test/api/v1/ingest \\
   -H 'Authorization: Bearer <staging-token>' \\
   -H 'X-User: \"\"; role=admin' \\
   -d '{"payload":"test"}'
 ```

 alex: response code 200 with acceptance. stack traces show `auth.middleware` returning 200 when `X-User` present even if token is scoped read-only.

 sam: omg — that's likely the RBAC change I rolled two commits ago where we split token scope vs header precedence. pinging @maria who owns that deploy.

 maria: yup saw that rollout. We added header-to-context parsing to support internal agents. It was behind config flag `ALLOW_HEADER_ASSERTION` which I thought was off in staging. I'll re-check.

 chen: can someone upload the raw zap/fuzz log and the DAST report? need the exact request id and response body to map to the auth middleware trace. also need correlation id header.

 alex: attaching snippet from zap (pastebin link): https://paste.redwood.internal/ci/3380001111-logs (contains request/response and replay). Correlation-id: x-corr-id=stg-9a2f.

 sec-bot: [SCAN-ALERT] interactive-dast found HIGH - authorization-bypass on /api/v1/ingest (score 8.7). Ticket created: SEC-1238.

 tara: next steps: 1) reproduce locally with a minimal server build (no middleware flags) 2) confirm whether `ALLOW_HEADER_ASSERTION` evaluated true in staging 3) if confirmed, rollback flag or patch to validate token scope against header.

 sam: I can repro locally in a containerized staging image. Quick test shows middleware logic does `if header.present -> set role` without validating token scope. Ugly.

 chen: for the audit trail — we need a KB entry with: evidence (zap request/response), affected commit SHA, deploy window, keystore logs (KMS decrypt events), and any ephemeral-service-account grants. Without KMS/DKeystore proof, we can't confirm privilege escalation.

 maria: KMS logs show no extra decrypts during that window, but we did grant an ephemeral service account `svc-collector` clusterrolebinding for 6h on 2025-03-09T02:00Z. Might be the agent that uses header assertions.

 alex: noted. attaching minimal repro PR I just opened: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4521 — it adds a defensive check in auth.middleware to verify token-scopes include asserted role.

 tara: please also add metric logging to the middleware and an event to the audit log when header assertions are used: `audit.event=header_assertion, user=..., token_scope=..., asserted_role=...` — that will help postmortem.

 sam: agree, we should also surface a rolling alert when header assertions exceed 1% of requests in staging for 10m.

 maria: I'll flip the staging flag back off now and redeploy the previous config. ETA ~12min.

 alex: after flip — I re-ran the fuzz harness, no reproduce. marking temp mitigation as success.

 chen: filing evidence bundle to SEC ticket: sec-1238 — includes zap report, correlation id, deploy diff, KMS logs snippet, and the PR link.

 sec-bot: [TICKET-UPDATE] SEC-1238 assigned to tara, priority P1, labels: sast,dast,rbac,audit.

 tara: I'll take triage lead. action items: (A) review PR 4521 and land defensive check (B) add audit log entry and metric (C) ask infra to rotate ephemeral binding policy for svc-collector and add least-privilege guardrails (D) confirm no production exposure.

 maria: rolling back staging flag complete. rolling prod check queued — won't change prod without signal.

 sam: quick idea — add unit test in auth lib asserting header assertion requires `token_scope:assert-role` permission; that'll prevent future drift.

 alex: agreed, added test in the PR.

 tara: timeline: land PR + audit logs (1h), infra rotate binding (2h), run full DAST + integration smoke (3h). I'll update SEC-1238 with statuses.

 chen: pinging compliance: we should keep evidence for 90 days and include KMS audit export. I'll add that to the ticket checklist.

 maria: FYI — there was a pre-merge exception I granted for the RBAC split change, approving the feature flag rollout. I'm adding notes to the repo change and tagging compliance.

 alex: anyone want to jump on a quick 15m call to walk through the replay and logs?

 sam: I'm free now.

 tara: me too, joining. :phone:

 sec-bot: [MEETUP] 15m call scheduled by tara in #meet — invite sent.

 maria: thanks all — I'll follow up on the deployment controls and RBAC policy.

 alex: thanks team. updating ticket now. :thumbsup:
